title: Shinonome Ena — Through Pain And Misery〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What should I draw for my sketch?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Something that lets me work on texturing... Oh, my brush and palette should do nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (While I'm at it, I can throw some paint on my palette...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, time to draw.
My brush, palette and paint should force me to really think about the texture for each.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to be more observant like Mr. Yukihira said and not go overboard with my shadowing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (When's the last time I worked on basic stuff like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: D-Do you think I can get better...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I kept running away from art... I regret doing that, but I was so sure that it was too late for me... And yet...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I do not know how or if you will improve...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: But that door will remain open as long as you're willing to face your own art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Ultimately, it's all up to me.
I won't get better unless I put in the effort...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm here too...
Which just leaves... Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay. Hello, Enanan.
About what you'll be doing today...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm gonna continue working on the rough draft for my illustration since I'm keeping you all waiting.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know I've wasted a bunch of time already, but I need you all to wait a little bit longer. I promise to get it done this week.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh... You don't have to rush, Enanan.
Just draw at your own pace.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I'll be fine. My mind's already made up and I'm gonna finish it this week.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I'll be looking forward to seeing what you draw.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Amia... I know I'm causing you the most trouble, but I need you to bear with me for just a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Don't forget to say something if you ever get stuck again, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That goes for you too, Yuki.
I still haven't forgotten about that question you asked. “Is this really everything you're trying to say?”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why do I get the feeling that you don't care at all...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (In terms of composition... I've tried framing it a few different ways, but this seems like the best choice.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Think about depth and distances...
The edges and contrast too. There's a lot of room for improvement...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh... It's already this late!
Why did I pick today to be a complete slowpoke?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll just keep wearing these while I continue what I started this afternoon!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm finally getting close to what I've been trying to draw this whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But it still looks pretty flat...
I need to make it clear that there's a third dimension.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This might be a bit much for a rough draft...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I've made everyone wait long enough. I should just keep at it and work out all these details while I can.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too. It's way easier to tell what you're trying to say compared to before!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll send over my comments after I've had a closer look at it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That includes you too, Yuki. Don't pull any punches, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be completely honest, I'm still not happy with it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But this is all that I'm capable of right now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mr. Yukihira was right. I need to relearn the basics and actually study this stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to if I'm gonna have any hope of producing illustrations that do Kanade and Mafuyu's songs justice!)
